name: Smart Thumbnails GW
author: Mohammadreza Maghsoudipour

sections.description:
Smart Thumbnails GW gives you full control over the image sizes generated by WordPress. Instead of creating unnecessary crops, this plugin allows you to define specific image sizes for each post type (posts, pages, products, etc.) through a simple user interface.

The core feature is its intelligent generation logic: custom sizes are created only for featured images when a post is saved, ensuring your server isn’t filled with unused image files from content uploads.

Main Features:

  • Dynamic Image Sizes: Add, and delete custom image sizes for any post type directly from the WordPress admin panel.
  • Intelligent Generation: Custom sizes are generated only for featured images, not for images uploaded into the post content.
  • Editor Agnostic: Works perfectly with both the Gutenberg and the Classic Editor.
  • Unused Image Cleanup: Automatically deletes unused featured images and WooCommerce gallery images when a post is permanently deleted.
  • AJAX Regenerate Tool: A powerful tool to regenerate featured images for all posts of a specific post type.
  • WooCommerce Integration: Control the thumbnail size used in the product gallery.

Source Code

The full source code, including the unminified JavaScript files, is included in the plugin directory under assets/js/.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the smart-thumbnails-gw folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
  3. Go to Settings -> Smart Thumbnails to configure the plugin and define your custom image sizes.
sections.faq:
I defined a new size. Why aren’t my old featured images showing it?

You need to regenerate thumbnails for existing images. Go to the plugin’s settings page, click on the “Regenerate Thumbnails” tab, select the post type, and start the regeneration process.

Will this plugin create sizes for images I upload to the post content?

No. To save server space, this plugin is designed to create custom sizes only for Featured Images. Images uploaded to the content area will not have custom sizes generated.

Can I define sizes for images uploaded directly to the Media Library?

Yes. In the “Image Sizes” tab, you will see a post type called “Media” (attachment). Any sizes you define there will be created for images uploaded directly to the Media Library.
